desc: Introducing the Cocoa Puffs Breakfast Cereal - 15.2oz, now available at Russell's Of Neillsville in Neillsville, WI. This delightful cereal is a breakfast favorite for both kids and adults alike, offering a deliciously chocolatey start to your day. With its irresistible taste and fun puffed shape, Cocoa Puffs makes breakfast an enjoyable experience for everyone in the family. Whether you're rushing out the door or enjoying a leisurely morning, this cereal is the perfect choice to fuel your day.
features:
Delicious Chocolate Flavor: Each bite is bursting with rich chocolatey goodness that will satisfy your sweet tooth.

Fun Puffed Shape: The unique puffed shape makes it fun to eat, whether you enjoy it with milk or straight from the box.

Versatile Breakfast Option: Perfect for breakfast, a snack, or even as a topping for yogurt or ice cream.

Whole Grain Goodness: Made with whole grains, Cocoa Puffs provides essential nutrients to kickstart your day.
ingredients: Whole Grain Corn, Sugar, Rice Flour, Corn Meal, Corn Syrup, Cocoa Processed with Alkali, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Color (Caramel Color and Annatto Extract), Salt, Baking Soda, Natural Flavor, Rosemary Extract. Vitamins and Minerals: Tricalcium Phosphate, Calcium Carbonate, Vitamin C (Sodium Ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (Mineral Nutrients), A B Vitamin (Niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (Pyridoxine Hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (Thiamin Mononitrate), Vitamin A (Palmitate), Vitamin B2 (Riboflavin), A B Vitamin (Folic Acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
